cues.text: Sometimes you measure the customer. More often you measure the garment. Both are easy.
Inseam: from the crotch seam to the bottom of the hem, along the inside of the leg.
Waist: around the body where the pants sit. Keep the tape snug, not tight.
Sleeve: from the shoulder seam to the end of the sleeve.
Most important: how much to change. Measure the old length, then the new length. The difference is what the tailor takes off.
If the customer brings a pair that already fits, lay both pairs flat and measure the inseam of the good pair.
Then write it, like: make inseam thirty inches, same as sample. Keep the sample pair with the ticket.
